highlights:
Turkiye: Turkiye is the real threat. There’s a lot of high-level European experience in the squad from Hakan Calhanoglu to Kerem Akturkoglu and beyond.
[...]
Turkiye is the USA’s toughest opponent, so it’s probably a good thing the USA can collect six points before the clash with the European side, which will likely be for the top spot in Group D.
[...]
A lot of eyes will be on Arda Guler when he plays for Turkiye, but if you’re betting player props, Akturkuoglu is the guy at +500 to be the team’s top scorer. He’s been a consistent scorer at Fenerbahce, Benfica and Galatasaray over the last few years. Guler could score a few bangers, but Akturkuglou is going to be the main man in front of the net.
[...]

Argentina: Group J is another group with a very clear favorite in Argentina.

Argentina’s World Cup run is going to be dominated by Lionel Messi, but Julian Alvarez needs to have a strong tournament for the Albiceleste to go back-to-back.

highlights:
Algeria FIFA World Cup 2026 preview: Player to watch out for, tactics, predicted playing XI - Sportstar
[...]
# Algeria FIFA World Cup 2026 preview: Petkovic and Mahrez’s experience key to the Dessert Warriors’ hopes
[...]
## Vladimir Petkovic taking over the helm makes Algeria a stronger contender than Austria for the second direct spot into the knockouts.
[...]
But heading into this World Cup, Algeria has the task of setting the record straight. It has multiple star names in its ranks in Riyad Mahrez, Rayan Ait Nouri, Ramy Bensebaini and Luca Zidane
[...]
Algeria hardly seems to be a team that will be intimidated by the weight of the occasion. However, its recent performances make it look like a team that caves in during big moments. In 2023, it suffered a shock group-stage exit in the Africa Cup of Nations. In 2025, it barely made it past DR Congo in the Round of 16 before losing out to Nigeria.
[...]
If Algeria can build on after a near-perfect CAF qualification run, winning eight of its 10 games, it could go deep into the competition. With its neighbour and arch-rival Morocco turning heads in 2022, Algeria will be spurred on to do even better this time.
[...]
Vladimir Petkovic, who coached Switzerland at the World Cup in 2018, taking over the helm makes Algeria a stronger contender than Austria for the second direct spot into the knockouts.
[...]
to watch out
[...]
Riyad Mahrez: Mahrez is no stranger to the grandest stage, having played for Manchester City during its treble-winning season. He has 38 goals for Algeria and is eight goals away from outstripping Islam Slimani. Doing so in four or five games might be a bit of a long shot, but at 35, Mahrez will not shy away from taking a shot.
[...]
There is as much at stake for Petkovic as for Algeria. His initiation at major tournaments was not the best when his side lost 0-2 convincingly to Nigeria in the AFCON quarterfinals. To defeat DR Congo one round earlier, Algeria needed extra-time. But in the lead-up to the World Cup, Algeria drew 0-0 with Uruguay and beat Netherlands 1-0 which suggests that Petkovic might just be hitting the right notes at the right time.
[...]

results.title: Algeria FIFA World Cup 2026 Guide: Squad, Petkovic, Mahrez & Group J Hopes | Fanorate
highlights:
Algeria blend a genuine global star in Riyad Mahrez with an exciting new wave of attacking talent. Mahrez, a Premier League and Champions League winner, remains the creative heartbeat, while the emergence of forwards like Mohamed Amoura and full-back Rayan Aït-Nouri gives the side fresh dynamism and pace.
[...]
Petković brings a pragmatic European structure to a squad that has historically been rich in flair but inconsistent in results. The combination of organisation and individual brilliance makes Algeria a dangerous, unpredictable opponent — and a serious threat to spring an upset in a top-heavy Group J.
[...]
Drawn alongside reigning champions Argentina, a returning Austria and debutants Jordan, Algeria face a stern test. Realistically they are competing with Austria for the second qualification spot, with the expanded format (third-placed teams can advance) giving them an extra lifeline.
[...]
Petković himself has publicly backed the side to challenge despite the Argentina test. Anything beyond the Round of 16 would match or beat their best-ever finish.
[...]
Algeria are capable of reaching the knockout rounds if they take care of business against Jordan and get a result against Austria.
[...]
Petković favours a structured, possession-aware approach, typically lining up in a 4-3-3 or 4-2-3-1. Algeria look to control midfield through Bennacer and build patiently, before unleashing the pace of Amoura and the creativity of Mahrez in the final third. The attacking full-backs, particularly Aït-Nouri, are central to their width.
[...]
Attack: 8/10 — Mahrez, Amoura and Gouiri give Algeria genuine cutting edge. Midfield: 7/10 — Bennacer and Bentaleb offer quality and control. Defense: 6/10 — Solid but can be vulnerable against top-tier movement.
[...]
Goalkeeping: 6/10 — A position of relative uncertainty without a standout No. 1. Depth: 7/10 — A deep pool of European-based talent. Experience: 7/10 — Mahrez and several veterans, but a relatively young core overall. A dangerous, talented side capable of reaching the knockouts.
[...]
- Riyad Mahrez at a World Cup — a chance to see one of football’s great wingers on the biggest stage.
- A vibrant, attacking style packed with pace and flair.
- The romance of an underdog with genuine upset potential in a tough group.
- Passionate Algerian support that brings colour and noise to every match.
[...]
Algeria are likely to battle Austria for second place in Group J, with the third-place qualification route a realistic fallback. If they navigate the group, a Round of 16 exit looks the probable ceiling against elite opposition — though Mahrez-inspired upsets can never be ruled out. Projected: knockout-round contenders, group qualification a coin-flip.
